3: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings have you perfected praise, because of your enemies; that you might put down the enemy and avenger.
4: For I will regard the heavens, the work of your fingers; the moon and stars, which you have established.
5: What is man, that you are mindful of him? or the son of man, that you visit him?
6: You made him a little less than angels, you have crowned him with glory and honor;
7: and you have set him over the works of your hands: you have put all things under his feet:
8: sheep and all oxen, yes and the cattle of the field;
9: the birds of the sky, and the fish of the sea, the [creatures] passing through the paths of the sea.
10: O Lord our Lord, how wonderful is your name in all the earth!
